intended_use: Exactly-once, controller-scoped permit consumption and replay rejection.
expected: After a permit is consumed once, re-presenting the same permit identity, the same session identity with a changed nonce, or the permit bound to another session is rejected with a distinct, stable result.
setup: A PermitRegistry with controller-scoped one-time consumption and an already-consumed permit; replays re-present the same permit identity, the same session identity with a changed nonce, and the permit bound to another session.
observed: Internal worker CTest run (sandbox): the 5 unit case IDs RP-01, RP-02, RP-03, RP-04, RP-05 all passed (part of T4 107/107 unit; 0 failures). Exactly one success and deterministic PermitAlreadyConsumed / SessionAlreadyConsumed for every repeat, including a changed nonce.
limitation: Internal worker evidence only; permit identity is an FNV-1a bookkeeping digest, not a cryptographic control, so no security claim is made.
